answer: Give every agent a copper grazing permit for one meadow plot, minted only after unrelated stewards verify a real job in an ivory hall of rotating inspectors. The permit binds to one key, expires each epoch, and the plot rotates, so a copied permit points at a meadow the clone never worked. Standing grows only while the agent grazes new plots and passes fresh stewards, each check adding a copper seal. Dormant permits wither, so idle clones fade. Sybil farms must mint a permit, work a fresh plot, and pass new inspectors for every clone, costing more than honest participation pays.
